name: President
tagline: Get rid of your cards first. Presidents rule; the Scum hands over their best.
rulesSummary: All cards are dealt. 2 is the highest card, then A, K, Q… down to 3. The holder of the 3♣ leads the first hand.
Play one card, or a set of the same rank. The next play must be the same number of cards and higher. Or pass — you can still play later in the trick.
When everyone else passes, whoever played last starts a new trick. Get rid of all your cards to go out.
First out is President (2 points), next Vice-President (1). Last is the Scum, and next-to-last the Vice-Scum.
Players then reseat in order of rank, so play goes President, Vice-President, … Scum. The Scum deals.
Next hand the Scum gives the President their 2 best cards and gets 2 of the President's choosing back (1 card between Vice-Scum and Vice-President). The President leads. First to 11 points wins.
